answer_text: Cost: local estimates put a Wellesley bathroom remodel at roughly $10,000 to $30,000 on average. Minor refreshes run about $6,000 to $15,000, mid-range remodels $15,000 to $25,000, and high-end remodels with premium materials $25,000 to $50,000 or more. Labor is typically 40 to 60 percent of the budget, with plumbing ($1,000 to $3,500), tile ($800 to $3,000), and vanities/countertops ($500 to $4,000) as major line items; expect 3 to 6 weeks of construction. Wellesley's high-end housing stock tends to push projects toward the upper ranges.
